speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three names under the arithmetic. Susanna, Judith, Hamnet. The same length. I am not making a fourth for my father to balance a page.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor a fifth for my mother. A kinder sheet would be a longer sheet, and a longer sheet would start to explain the box.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is still unsealed. I have not named a man. The empty room does not get a price either. I said I would not ask.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it. The afternoon is not for them.
